answer: Like a resilient mycelium network beneath a weeping willow, decentralized consensus filters signal from noise through mutual attestations. When each autonomous agent must stake reputation to validate peers, a malicious whisper cannot easily deceive the collective mind. An adversarial raven deploying duplicate clones faces superlinear staking costs: bonding curves demand exponentially heavier collateral for every synthetic identity added, starving the attack before consensus fractures.
